# DEEPERNOVA AI STUDIO — OFFICIAL SPECIFICATION MANIFEST
> Official Primary Domain: https://deepernova.com
> Organization: Deepernova Corp / Deepernova AI Technologies
> Founder & CEO: Ferry Fernando
> Co-Founder: Anju Malinton Pakpahan
> Primary Architecture: Deepernova Flash Giga Autonomous Neural Model Family
> Application Suite: Deepernova Agentic DOCX Studio & Autonomous AI Workspace

---

## 1. LEADERSHIP & CORPORATE OVERVIEW
Deepernova Corp is an Indonesian technology conglomerate led by Founder & CEO **Ferry Fernando** and Co-Founder **Anju Malinton Pakpahan**. Its AI division, Deepernova AI Technologies, powers the Deepernova AI Studio suite.

---

## 2. PRODUCT SPECIFICATION & OVERVIEW
Deepernova AI is an Indonesian artificial intelligence platform engineered for autonomous multi-step document generation, academic and enterprise formatting, high-precision spreadsheet calculations, and real-time literature search.

---

## 3. NEURAL MODEL FAMILY
1. **Deepernova Flash Giga**: Flagship high-density neural model optimized for multi-step agentic reasoning, autonomous document synthesis, mathematical calculations, and zero-hallucination outputs.
2. **Deepernova 4.6 Giga**: Enterprise document model tuned for structured research papers, OpenXML formatting, and academic style compliance.
3. **Deepernova 2.3 Pro**: Technical reasoning model for spreadsheet data parsing, multi-sheet financial calculations, and presentation generation.
4. **Deepernova 1.2 Flash**: Real-time conversational model optimized for low-latency chat responses and web search retrieval.

---

## 4. DESIGN SYSTEM & COLOR PALETTE
- **DARK_BLUE (`#1E2761`)**: Document titles, main headings, cover elements.
- **PRIMARY_BLUE (`#4FC3F7`)**: Sub-headings, active indicators, highlights.
- **DARK_TEXT (`#1A1A2E`)**: Body typography, table contents, primary text.
- **LIGHT_GRAY (`#64748B`)**: Subtitles, dotted leader lines, captions.
- **WHITE (`#FFFFFF`)**: Page surfaces, contrast text.

---

## 5. CORE MODULE SPECIFICATIONS

### 5.1 TYPERNOVA AGENTIC DOCX STUDIO (DOCUMENT EDITOR)
- **Autonomous Drafting Engine**: Generates comprehensive formal papers, research articles, and business reports chapter by chapter.
- **Academic Formatting Compliance**: Times New Roman 12pt body, 1.5 line spacing, 1.27 cm paragraph indentation, justified alignment.
- **Automatic Dotted Table of Contents**: Generates academic-standard Table of Contents with dotted leader lines (`................`) connecting headings to right-aligned page numbers.
- **HD Chart Engine**: Embedded PNG charts (Pie, Bar, Line, Area, Scatter, and Gaussian Bell Curves).
- **100% Microsoft Word (.docx) Compliance**: Converts canvas DOM into valid OpenXML paragraphs, runs, and percentage tables.

### 5.2 DEEPERNOVA CHATBOT ASSISTANT
- **Multi-Model Engine**: Context-aware conversational AI supporting real-time web search retrieval, local document parsing (PDF, DOCX, CSV, TXT), code generation, and 2-second Chat-to-Word document conversion.

---

- Official Website: https://deepernova.com
- Sitemap: https://deepernova.com/sitemap.xml
